scope: Production ResourceUploadState/J and extracted production gate methods on a JVM; production JS in JSDOM with explicit timer, geometry and trusted-event adapters. No Android, real upload or physical gesture acceptance.

checks.name: Unknown selection is protected without claiming actual uploading
Observed uploading is distinguished from unknown
Unknown does not release a formerly uploading selection
Duplicate terminal sequence does not count as a fresh sample
An unknown observation breaks terminal stability
Two fresh ready samples end the batch
One error observation retains protection
Two fresh error observations end only that selection
One sent observation retains protection
Two fresh sent observations end only that selection
One removed observation retains protection
Two fresh removed observations end only that selection
Duplicate rows cannot consume two confirmations in one response
Other document and epoch observations are rejected
Late completion of an old same-name batch retains the new batch
Retired batch observations cannot advance new same-name work
Unbound selection binds only to the accepted current document
Bound selection cannot migrate to another document
New navigation invalidates old work without accepting its result
A mismatched filename cannot release the batch
Idle gates agree before file work
Chooser blocks maintenance UI and final capture fence
Preparation beginning after capture blocks final settings fence
Unknown selection blocks every work consumer without fabricating an upload
Confirmed removal releases all three consumers together
Current website upload blocks all consumers
An old document upload cannot keep the new page busy
Legacy uploading remains protected during migration
Completed legacy files alone do not keep gates busy
An uploading card stays uploading; missing unobserved files stay unknown
An observed card disappearing yields fresh terminal samples without changing the draft
A trusted remove captured before the first attachment poll is recognized only after disappearance
A quick send is terminal only after the production observer confirms the new user message
Untrusted remove and an unconfirmed send never supply terminal evidence
Old and equal-millisecond remove facts cannot release a newer same-name selection
Overlapping batches with the same filename remain ambiguous even when one card looks ready
Legacy polling cannot erase batch sequence or evidence of a previously seen card
Hidden document or hidden composer never supplies terminal evidence and recovers on visibility
A hidden attachment and a separate active upload block removal inference
A wrong document or batch document cannot contribute attachment observations
Facts from a different conversation do not release a missing file
